gloss: drastically; completely; with one clean cut

definitions.explanation: Describes cutting something off completely or making a decisive, drastic change.
Describes the sound or manner of cutting something cleanly and decisively.

examples.japanese: ⟦{髪|かみ}→髪：02196_kami⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ばっさり⟦{切|き}った→切る：02693_kiru⟧。
examples.english: I cut my hair drastically short.

⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{提案|ていあん}→提案：03536_teian⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧ばっさり⟦{却下|きゃっか}された→却下：05908_kyakka⟧。
⟦{庭|にわ}→庭：02239_niwa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{木|き}→木：00524_ki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{枝|えだ}→枝：02181_eda⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ばっさり⟦{切|き}り{落|お}とした→切り落とす：28973_kiriotosu⟧。

examples.english: He was cut down with one clean stroke of the sword.

notes:
USAGE:
ばっさり conveys decisiveness and finality—a clean, complete cut or elimination without hesitation.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ばっさり⟦{切|き}る→切る：02693_kiru⟧: to cut drastically/decisively
- ばっさり⟦{削|けず}る→削る：03922_kezuru⟧: to cut drastically (budget, etc.)
- ばっさり⟦{断|ことわ}る→断る：02102_kotowaru⟧: to flatly refuse
- ばっさり⟦{捨|す}てる→捨てる：00892_suteru⟧: to throw away completely

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦すっぱり→すっぱり：noentry⟧: cleanly, completely (for quitting habits)
- ⟦きっぱり→きっぱり：06354_kippari⟧: flatly, decisively (for statements)
- ⟦さっぱり→さっぱり：02777_sappari⟧: refreshingly (after cleaning up)
